'''Songsteel Heights''' was an area in [[District 1327|Breaktown]] on [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 7" /> In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Senya Tirall]] and [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] passed the Heights during their search for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]], fighting many [[Heralds of Zildrog]] to reach the [[Razor (Zakuul)|Razor]].<ref name="KotFE 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
Songsteel Heights appears as an area on Zakuul in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 7" />
